provenance.basis: Even B-stave channels are the primary positive-going analysis channels; odd duplicate readouts are inverted relative to the even partner (see s28a / duplicate-readout studies).
provenance.note: Odd-channel polarity is locked to -1 so polarity[c]*(raw-baseline) yields a positive physical pulse for both even and odd partners. Re-measure with scripts/channel_polarity.py::infer_channel_polarity before changing this map.
